3.1.evidence:

(1) The Integrated Services as referred to in Article 6 shall be established by the Regent in accordance with the prevailing laws and regulations.
23. Integrated Services is a series of activities to provide protection for victims of gender-based violence and children carried out jointly by relevant agencies or institutions as one unified implementation, prevention efforts, health services, medicolegal services, psychosocial rehabilitation, repatriation, social reintegration, and legal assistance for victims of gender-based violence and children.
3.1.rationale: The policy explicitly provides for “Integrated Services” to assist the Regional Government in protecting victims of gender-based violence, mandates their establishment by the Regent, and defines them as a unified mechanism delivering multiple victim services (health, medicolegal, psychosocial rehabilitation, reintegration, legal assistance). This meets the requirement for an integrated/one-stop service mechanism for victims (including women victims of gender-based violence).
